Title: Phycoprobe Data - Yearly Combine

Description: Combine cleaned phycoprobe files from a given year

By: Perry

Date: 11/2023


```{r}
# ---
# EDIT THIS
# ---

# define year of interest
year <- 2024
```

```{r}
# ---
# CODE STARTS HERE
# ---

# read in packages
library(tidyverse)
library(data.table)
source(here::here('03_Phyto/01_routine/phyco-cleaning/functions/phyco_funcs.R'))

fp_phyco <- clean_path(year)

df_comb <- rbindlist(lapply(fp_phyco, fread), fill = TRUE) %>%
  arrange(DateTime)

df_comb <- df_comb %>%
  mutate(Date = as.Date(DateTime),
         Time = format(DateTime, format = '%H:%M:%S')) %>%
  select(-any_of(c(DateTime,Year)))

write_csv(df_comb, fp_main_export(year))
```
